name: aether-mail
description: Local-first Thunderbird-shaped mail client with a Hermes-shaped agent

scripts.dev: npm run dev -w @aether/api & npm run dev -w @aether/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @aether/web && npm run build -w @aether/api
scripts.desktop:build: npm run sidecar:build && tauri build --config apps/desktop/tauri.conf.json
